title: Add a project README
body:
The repository has an incomplete README.

**Tasks**
- [ ] Describe the goal of the project
- [ ] Explain how to set up the environment / install dependencies
- [ ] Explain how to reproduce the analysis (which scripts to run, in which order)
- [ ] List the group members and their contributions

A clear README makes it much easier for others (like new team members) to understand and run the project.

title: Set up project folder structure
body:
Agree on and create a consistent folder structure for the project, for example:

```
/data        raw and processed data (or scripts that generate/download it)
/src         source code (scraping, cleaning, analysis)
/output      figures, tables, and other generated results
/docs        report, presentation, and other written deliverables
```

**Tasks**
- [ ] Create the folders listed above (or an agreed alternative)
- [ ] Move existing files into the right place
- [ ] Add a short note in the README explaining the structure

title: Produce a clean Quarto summary for one selected CSV file
body:
The project requires a clean summary of one selected CSV file to be produced using Quarto.

**Tasks**
- [ ] Select one CSV file from the `/data/raw` (see issue "Download the data from the provided URL and save it to the data folder")
- [ ] Create a Quarto document that reads the CSV file and produces a summary (e.g., descriptive statistics, visualizations)
- [ ] Save the Quarto document in the correct folder
- [ ] Ensure that the Quarto document can be rendered without errors

title: Download the data from the provided URL and save it to the data folder
body:
The project requires a specific dataset to be downloaded from a provided URL.

**Tasks**
- [ ] Write a script that downloads the data from the given URL
- [ ] Save the downloaded file to the `/data/raw` folder
- [ ] Ensure that the script can be run multiple times without errors (e.g., check if the file already exists before downloading)

title: Create an AI.md file to document AI usage
body:
The project allowes and encourages the use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) to assist with coding and writing. It's important to document how these tools were used.

**Tasks**
- [ ] Create a new file named `AI.md`.
- [ ] List the AI tools used, including versions and settings
- [ ] Describe how each tool was used (e.g., code generation, debugging, writing assistance)
- [ ] Explain how the outputs from AI tools were reviewed and validated
